name: Cleanaway
h1: Blueprint 2030 2.0, run on one connected layer
lede: Cleanaway is lifting margins through pricing, productivity and technology enablement while modernising IT. Airtable gives the teams delivering that plan one shared view of the work.
why_p: A transitional FY27 with heavier IT investment, a pending change of ownership and a refreshed strategy all put pressure on how programs are tracked and reported.

signals.title: EQT signs binding deal to acquire Cleanaway
signals.body: EQT Infrastructure VI entered a Scheme Implementation Deed at A$3.095 per share, an implied enterprise value of about A$9.3bn, subject to shareholder and court approval.
signals.angle: Ownership transitions demand clear, auditable visibility of every operational program and its status.

signals.title: FY26 results and a transitional FY27
signals.body: Underlying EBIT rose 14.2% to $470.2m. FY27 guidance of $500m to $530m absorbs higher IT and Blueprint 2030 spend.
signals.angle: Track IT modernisation and Blueprint workstreams in one place so spend maps clearly to outcomes.

signals.title: New CFO as FY26 guidance is reaffirmed
signals.body: Cleanaway appointed Nigel Simonsz as CFO, succeeding Paul Binfield, and reaffirmed FY26 earnings guidance.
signals.angle: A new finance lead benefits from a single source of truth for program costs, benefits and milestones.

signals.title: Strategy refresh targets margin growth
signals.body: Blueprint 2030 2.0 focuses on getting more from the existing platform through pricing, productivity and technology, converting earnings into stronger free cash flow.
signals.angle: Give productivity and pricing initiatives a shared operating rhythm across regions and divisions.
